articles.title: New Clarity Act text tweaks DeFi, credit union provisions, but road ahead for bill remains murky
articles.snippet: The Clarity Act needs 60 votes when the Senate returns from its recess next week. Republicans circulated a fresh draft on Thursday ahead of the vote.

articles.title: Bitcoin Suisse to shift up to half of Swiss jobs abroad
articles.snippet: The Swiss crypto financial services firm plans to move back-office functions to lower-cost international hubs as it expands its global wealth and asset management business, according to Finews.

articles.title: Metaplanet cuts Series 10 stock pool by 41%, plans Hong Kong subsidiary
articles.snippet: Metaplanet will cut 131.3 million potential shares and form a $1 million Hong Kong subsidiary for trading in Bitcoin, equities and credit products.

articles.title: Bitcoin buyers wary of July sub-$58K floor amid onchain data ‘anomaly’
articles.snippet: Bitcoin HODL waves data revealed an unusually muted reaction to Bitcoin’s drop below $58,000, raising questions over its status as a bear-market floor.

articles.title: Brevo login flaw enabled phishing email targeting 347K Trezor subscribers
articles.snippet: Trezor told Cointelegraph that the phishing email was sent to 347,000 subscribers and said it is treating every address as “known to the attacker and possibly reusable for phishing.”
